subject: Re: Pilot credits & pricing — burn rate check / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: Pilot recap & next steps

Hey Alex — great chat today, thanks for walking through the integration plan. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned:

- What we heard: Acme Health wants to power the patient triage assistant and internal summarization pipeline. Initial scope: 2 models (conversation + summarization), expected monthly token volume ~2.5M–3.0M tokens for the Proof-of-Concept (POC).
- Burn-rate today (rough): ~110k–140k tokens/day based on your test workload (you mentioned heavy summarization batches on demo data).
- Primary success metric for POC: reduce triage time by 30% and maintain summary ROUGE >= baseline. Secondary: unit cost target.

Pricing / unit economics we discussed:
- Target unit: $/1M tokens. You mentioned your internal target is roughly $700–1,200 per 1M tokens for POC economics.
- Based on that target and the 2.5M–3.0M monthly volume, we sketched a target monthly spend of ~$1,750–$4,800 (at $700/1M) up to ~$3,000–$4,800 (at $1,200/1M).

Pilot credits request:
- You asked for an additional credits extension to get through the full 30-day POC; current pilot credits will run out in ~9 days at the current burn.
- Proposed internal ask: $12,000 in pilot credits (equivalent to ~10M–17M tokens depending on model mix/quantization) to give you headroom to finish integration, run stability tests, and collect quality metrics.

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the expected avg tokens/day for the next 30 days (conservative estimate)?
2) If procurement needs formal wording, can you loop in procurement@acmehealth.com and I'll send a short form?
3) I'll request a pilot-credit approval internally once you confirm the exact extension amount (or if you want us to propose an amount).

Thanks — I'll follow up with internal approvals once I have your confirmation on the burn estimate.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: acme-burn-rate-snapshot.csv (summary of demo run)

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pilot recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers: 

- Confirmed conservative avg: ~120k tokens/day (we saw spikes to 150k on heavier days). That maps to ~3.6M tokens/month.
- Procurement is cc'd; our initial budget for the POC is $5k–15k depending on performance and SLAs.
- The $700–1,200/1M range is realistic for us; ideally we target the lower end but we can flex.

We'd appreciate the pilot credits extension. 12k sounds generous — if you can approve something in the $6k–$12k range that should be enough depending on how you account for model mix. For now, please propose a number and any guardrails (per-model caps, expiry).

I'll also set up a 30-min check-in for next week to review early metrics.

— Alex
Head of Data Products, Acme Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@lauren_bishop.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-19T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits request — Acme Health (need approval)

Forwarding Alex's note — Acme is asking for a pilot credits extension to cover an expected ~3.6M tokens/month POC (conservative). They signaled a $5k–15k internal budget.

Requested: Can we approve a one-time $10,000 pilot credit extension (expiration 60 days) with the following guardrails:
- Per-model daily cap: 250k tokens/day total across account
- Expiry: 60 days from issuance
- Billing owner notified: Lauren for any overages beyond credits

Rationale: $10k gives them enough runway (approx equivalent to 8–12M tokens depending on model mix/segmentation) to complete integration and provide meaningful telemetry for model recommendations. They're a high-fit healthcare GTM motion and likely to move to Dedicated capacity if POC metrics look good.

Attachments: pilot-credit-approval-form.pdf, acme-burn-rate-snapshot.csv

Thanks — Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot credits request — Acme Health (need approval)

Marissa — I'm okay approving $10,000 in credits for the POC with the guardrails you proposed. A couple notes: 
- Please log the deal in HubSpot and flag the opportunity for a Q1 Dedicated follow-up if they hit >3M tokens/mo sustained.
- Finance wants a short usage SLA: notify Lauren at 80% credit consumption so we can evaluate mid-flight.

Approving now. Dev — can you execute the credit issuance and add per-model caps? Lauren — I'll loop you on billing/overage alerts.

Jonas
Director, Sales Ops

Alex — good news: we've approved a $10,000 one-time pilot credit extension for Acme Health. Summary of the approval and guardrails below: 

- Amount: $10,000 in pilot credits (applied to your account once procurement confirms any required PO language).
- Expiry: 60 days from issuance.
- Guardrails: per-account daily cap of 250k tokens/day; automatic notification to Lauren at 80% consumption; overages billed at standard list rates unless we agree otherwise.
- Next steps for procurement: if you want a short form agreement, procurement@acmehealth.com please reply and I'll push a one-page amendment.
- Internal follow-ups: HubSpot deal ACME-2026-0114 updated with credit issuance and follow-up task to review POC metrics in 30 days (Marissa).

I'll issue the credits once procurement confirms PO wording (if any) or confirms no PO needed. Proposed check-in: Wed 11/25 10am PT to review early telemetry — shall I send a calendar invite?

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa
